purpose: Independent prospective, nonprotected numerical control of late-twilight solar-component dependence on solar depression, with other physical inputs fixed; not a model fit or observed star test.

newIdentityCandidate.preDispatchCheck: Must reverify all ref/branch/ordinal/seed collisions; any collision forces a new *pre-result* preregistration, never silent replacement

analysisFrozenBeforeNewResults.verify: All member SHA-256, input/seed/atmosphere identity, finite nonnegative 8001-node strictly increasing 380..780 nm grid; exact zeros remain censored/underprecision
analysisFrozenBeforeNewResults.integration: Trapezoid of raw wavelength/radiance; NO photopic, SQM or physical-units conversion without separate calibration
analysisFrozenBeforeNewResults.standardError: Four independent block integrated estimates: sample_stdev/sqrt(4); RSEM=SE/mean if mean>0; no epsilon substituted for zero
analysisFrozenBeforeNewResults.numericalReadiness: RSEM <= 0.30 at BOTH depths; zero-block mixtures fail numerical readiness regardless of RSEM
analysisFrozenBeforeNewResults.monotonicity: Pair blocks by ordered seeds, let Di=L(10.75)_i - L(15.5)_i. Require mean(D)-3.182446305*sample_stdev(D)/sqrt(4)>0.
analysisFrozenBeforeNewResults.fail: Any drift, missing case, exact-zero mixture, unacceptable precision, monotonicity failure, or unavailable normal workflow => FAIL_CLOSED/UNDERPRECISION; never rerun same identity
analysisFrozenBeforeNewResults.allowedPass: PASS_INTERNAL_SOLAR_GRADIENT_ONLY, not external sky validation or model-v1 release

executionGuards: Verify actual America/New_York time, Brooklyn Shabbat and diaspora Yom-Tov blackout
Fresh Issue #60 and workboard #152; exact refs; complete mutable Actions and dispatch counts; WQ/snapshot and worker states
Fresh unique branch, ordinal, seeds, unspent scientific identity, unchanged source/runtime hashes
Use only normally authorized high-level runner; never bypass a platform safety denial
No paid commitments or new purchases
Never open internal protected data, Taylor/Jerusalem holdouts, or perform outcome-driven re-selection
